name: intraday-equities-development-simulation
notes: ADR-0182: the production-equivalent historical simulation, folds 2..19 (2022-09-09..2025-10-16). DEVELOPMENTAL POST-SELECTION, deployment_eligible=false everywhere: the tradable set, leads and caps are the P16 gate admission (gates 77a7ab08, evidence through 2025-10-16), passed to EquityKellyMIO only through the declared cap_evidence_look_ahead switch (caps use post-selection evidence, look-ahead disclosed). Each P16 fold is one model release (the program calendar's development_outer schedule IS the retrain rule); its stored out-of-sample yhat is the inference at each 30-minute lattice tick, calibrated only on earlier folds' residuals. simulate replays one segment per release through EquityReplay + ServeLoop with next-bar-open fills and Schwab costs (fill-policy.json), $1,000 seed + $20 per trading day (cash-flow-policy.json), cash carried across releases. Every MIO risk knob in decide is an ADR-0182 development placeholder, not an owner ruling. Run from the child root: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-development-simulation.json --adapter intraday_equities. Outputs land beside the run dir under ./pipeline_runs (no $run_dir reference exists); a second run refuses to overwrite them.

bars_a.notes: Split-adjusted SIP minutes holding the admitted LLY and XLK (and the other P13 names this source carries, dropped by simulate). start_ms = the fold-2 cutoff 2022-09-09; end_ms (exclusive) = 2025-10-17, the day after evidence_end, so nothing after the evidence window is read. RTH only, the tape the P16 labels count lead bars on.

bars_e.notes: Split-adjusted SIP minutes holding the admitted ADBE, CIEN, LITE, LRCX, LULU, MSTR, NOW, PANW, TER. Same window as bars_a.

params.provenance_waiver: Each bar record already carries its source; the two sources' symbol namespaces are disjoint and checked below.

publish.notes: One release per fold: cap artifact (TRUE stamps, never a confirmation), survivors and leads read from the pinned gates.json, per-lead attested uncertainty calibrated on folds < k inside the trailing 730 days; one ForecastBundle per (lattice tick, lead group), yhat only.

decide.notes: EquityKellyMIO base params, sized per tick inside simulate on live cash; bundle/cap pins and Schwab cost knobs are bound per tick (from the publisher and fill-policy.json). ADR-0182 development placeholders, not owner rulings.

params.source: ADR-0182 development simulation fills (developmental post-selection, not deployment evidence)
